faq_heading: Homes near White Rock Christian Academy: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near White Rock Christian Academy get a child a place?
faq.a: No. White Rock Christian Academy is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the White Rock Christian Academy home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names White Rock Christian Academy, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near White Rock Christian Academy sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 730 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,349,500, townhomes $840,000, condos $532,500. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near White Rock Christian Academy?
faq.a: Within 2 km of White Rock Christian Academy the median was 30 days on the market, closing at 96.8% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 730 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to White Rock Christian Academy?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Star of the Sea (0.4 km north-west), Jessie Lee Elementary (0.6 km south-east) and Newbridge Academy (0.7 km south).

White Rock Christian Academy is an independent school in Surrey, at 2265 152 St. It teaches kindergarten to grade 12.
The search below lists homes for sale whose listing names White Rock Christian Academy. Under it are the prices homes sold for within 2 km of the school.
How the White Rock Christian Academy search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names White Rock Christian Academy, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of White Rock Christian Academy sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 730 homes sold within 2 km of White Rock Christian Academy: 92 houses, 200 townhomes and 400 condos. The largest group was condos, at a median of $532,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of White Rock Christian Academy

17 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of White Rock Christian Academy in a straight line (12 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 4 independent). The closest is Star of the Sea, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Edgewood Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Semiahmoo Secondary (1.2 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Jessie Lee Elementary (0.6 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-12) is Southridge School, 1.8 km north-east of White Rock Christian Academy.
